title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线不是又多了几个模型，而是模型能力开始真正改变工作方式：价格下降让 agent 可以进入更多任务，formal verification 开始变成 coding workflow 的一部分，3D 生成也提醒 builder 先把产品的核心循环想清楚。与此同时，Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Sol/Luna 把竞争推到了一个更现实的维度：谁能以更低的 token 成本，把复杂工作稳定交付出来。

archive.title: 模型降价日报
archive.desc: 前沿模型同时变强又变便宜，agent 开始进入验证、企业分析和创作工作流，但产品判断仍然比功能数量更重要。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-09-24 source feeds.

sections.title: Frontier Models, Lower Cost / 前沿模型，成本下探
sections.desc: 模型发布的看点不只在榜单，真正的变化是复杂任务的单位成本正在下降。

rewrite: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux announced GPT-6 Sol and Luna, describing them as a significant improvement across the board, including writing and the hard-to-measure quality you notice when you actually use a model.

The practical headline is price: API pricing is being cut by 50%, making the models viable for a much wider set of use cases. Plus, Pro and Business users get a banked reset, so the launch is also about making existing usage go further.
original: GPT-6 Sol and Luna are out. Not only are they a very significant improvement across the board, but also in writing and general "you know when you try it" quality.
We are also permanently reducing the API price by 50% making both of them viable for a ton of new usecases and making your usage go further too, even on the subscriptions.

rewrite: OpenAI 的 Thibault Sottiaux 宣布 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 上线，称它们在整体能力、写作，以及那种「真正用起来才知道」的综合质感上都有明显提升。
更实际的重点是价格：API 价格永久下调 50%，让更多场景具备经济可行性。Pro 和 Business 用户还会获得一次 banked reset，这次发布本质上也是让现有额度更耐用。
original: GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 上线了。它们不只是在各方面有很大提升，写作和整体的‘用起来才知道’的质量也提升了。
API 价格永久下调 50%，让它们适用于更多新场景，也让订阅用户的使用量更耐用。

rewrite: Claude Code engineer Boris Cherny says Opus 5.5 has been his daily driver. In a head-to-head port of HAProxy from C to Rust, Opus 5.5 finished in 9.5 hours versus Fable 5.1's 12 hours, while costing 51% less; both passed nearly all of HAProxy's tests.
That is a more useful model comparison than a leaderboard position: time, cost, and test results on a real engineering task.
original: We had Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 each port HAProxy from C to Rust. Both passed nearly all of HAProxy's tests, but Opus 5.5 finished in 9.5 hours compared to Fable 5.1's 12 hours, and for 51% less cost.

rewrite: Claude Code 工程师 Boris Cherny 说，Opus 5.5 已经是他日常使用的主力模型。在一次把 HAProxy 从 C 移植到 Rust 的对比中，Opus 5.5 用时 9.5 小时，Fable 5.1 用时 12 小时，前者成本还低 51%；两者都通过了 HAProxy 几乎全部测试。
这比单看 leaderboard 更有参考价值：同一个真实工程任务，比较时间、成本和测试结果。
original: Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 都把 HAProxy 从 C 移植到了 Rust。两者都通过了几乎全部测试，但 Opus 5.5 用时 9.5 小时，Fable 5.1 用时 12 小时，成本低 51%。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie frames the price cuts as an agent version of Jevons paradox: when tokens get cheaper, demand for them expands and entirely new use cases become affordable.

His examples are concrete—agents processing company data, scanning code for security issues, reading logs to make decisions, and coordinating swarms in workflows. The cost per token is becoming a direct constraint on what businesses can automate.
original: The rate at which the cost per task drops in AI is unlike any other type of technology in history.
Every time the cost of AI drops, the use-cases you can deploy agents against dramatically increase.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 把这轮降价解释成 agent 时代的 Jevons paradox：token 越便宜，对它的需求反而会扩张，原本负担不起的用例会变得可行。
他的例子很具体：让 agent 处理企业数据、扫描代码找安全问题、阅读日志做决策，以及在 workflow 里运行 agent swarm。token 成本正在直接决定企业到底能自动化什么。
original: AI 每项任务的成本下降速度，是历史上任何其他技术都无法相比的。
每当 AI 成本下降，可以部署 agent 的用例就会大幅增加。

sections.title: Coding Agents Learn to Check Themselves / Coding agent 开始自证
sections.desc: agent 不只是在写代码，也开始验证代码、寻找并发问题，并把形式化方法带进日常开发。

rewrite: Boris Cherny used Opus 5.5 to formally verify the Claude Agent SDK with Lean. A couple of short prompts produced 16 PRs that fixed bugs and race conditions, and he also combines Lean with TLA+ to examine data flow, concurrency, and state management.

The striking part is not that a model can write formal-methods code. It is that formal verification is becoming a practical bug-finding loop for a builder who says he does not know either language well.
original: I used Opus 5.5 to formally verify the Claude Agent SDK using Lean. A couple short prompts = 16 PRs fixing various bugs and race conditions.
TLA+ also works well. I sometimes combine Lean and TLA+ to look for issues around data flow, concurrency, and state mgmt.

rewrite: Boris Cherny 用 Opus 5.5 和 Lean 对 Claude Agent SDK 做形式化验证。几个简短 prompt 产出了 16 个 PR，修复了各种 bug 和 race condition；他还会把 Lean 与 TLA+ 结合起来检查数据流、并发和状态管理。
真正值得注意的不是模型会写形式化方法代码，而是形式化验证开始变成一个实用的找 bug loop，即使 builder 自己也说并不熟悉这两门语言。
original: 我用 Opus 5.5 和 Lean 对 Claude Agent SDK 做了形式化验证。几个简短 prompt 就产生了 16 个 PR，修复了各种 bug 和 race condition。
TLA+ 也很好用。我有时会把 Lean 和 TLA+ 结合起来，寻找数据流、并发和状态管理方面的问题。

rewrite: Peter Steinberger says Astra found a roughly 14-year-old bug in libuv after ChatGPT started crashing for him following a macOS 27 update.
It is a small but telling example of where agents are useful: not just generating new code, but digging through mature infrastructure and finding defects that have survived for years.
original: Had ChatGPT sometimes crashing on me after updating to macOS 27 and... Astra found a ~14 year old bug in libuv.

rewrite: Peter Steinberger 说，macOS 27 更新后 ChatGPT 偶尔崩溃，最后是 Astra 找到了 libuv 里一个大约存在了 14 年的 bug。
这是 agent 价值的一个小而典型的例子：它不只是生成新代码，也能钻进成熟基础设施里，找到已经潜伏多年的缺陷。
original: 更新 macOS 27 后 ChatGPT 有时会崩溃，然后 Astra 找到了 libuv 里一个大约 14 年历史的 bug。

sections.title: Build the Loop Before the Feature / 先做对循环
sections.desc: 能力越强，越容易被功能数量带偏；真正的产品判断仍然从用户和核心使用循环开始。

rewrite: Thariq's advice for builders using powerful models is deliberately counterintuitive: do not ship 10x more features to production. Spend the extra capacity understanding users, running experiments, building prototypes, and learning what you do not understand.
The point is simple: model capability should buy better product decisions, not just a longer roadmap.
original: The right way to use model capabilities is not to ship 10x more features to prod.
It's to spend more time understanding your users, trying experiments, building prototypes, learning about things you don't understand so that you can ship things that actually work.

rewrite: Thariq 给使用强模型的 builder 提了一个反直觉建议：不要把能力全部换成 10 倍多的线上功能，而是把省下来的时间用来理解用户、做实验、搭 prototype，搞懂那些自己还不了解的东西。
核心意思很简单：模型能力应该换来更好的产品判断，而不只是更长的 roadmap。
original: 正确使用模型能力的方式，不是把 10 倍多的功能发布到生产环境。
而是花更多时间理解用户、尝试实验、构建 prototype，学习不了解的东西，从而发布真正能工作的产品。

rewrite: On 3D generation and games, Thariq gives himself the same reminder: generative 3D can help you imagine a game coming to life, but you still need to figure out a good, satisfying game loop first.
More generation makes the blank canvas smaller. It does not decide whether the thing is fun.
original: If you want to make games, 3d generation is a great capability to help you imagine your game come to life.
But you should figure out how to make a good, satisfying game loop first.

rewrite: 谈到 3D generation 和游戏，Thariq 也给自己提了同样的醒：生成式 3D 很适合帮助你想象游戏变成现实，但你仍然得先想清楚一个好玩、令人满足的 game loop。
生成能力让空白画布变小了，但它不会替你决定这东西是否有趣。
original: 如果你想做游戏，3D generation 是帮助你想象游戏成真的好能力。
但你应该先想清楚怎么做出一个好的、令人满足的 game loop。

sections.title: A More Capable Creative Stack / 更强的创作栈
sections.desc: 从历史街景到可部署的软件，模型开始把复杂创作任务变成可执行的工作流。

rewrite: Anthropic researcher Alex Albert has been using Opus 5.5 with Blender to build a historically accurate version of San Francisco's Market Street as it stood in 1906, before the earthquake.

The experiment is more than one-shot image generation: the prompt asks for source-backed buildings, reusable procedural generators, and a 10-second video. Better 3D modeling and vision turn a single prompt into the starting point for a whole world-building workflow.
original: I've been on a Blender kick with Opus 5.5. Its better 3D modeling and vision mean you can build an entire world from a single prompt.
Historically accurate San Francisco Market street in 1906, pre-earthquake

rewrite: Anthropic 研究员 Alex Albert 最近一直在用 Opus 5.5 配合 Blender，重建 1906 年地震前、具有历史准确性的旧金山 Market Street。
这个实验不只是一次性生成图片：prompt 要求为建筑建立有来源的资料、编写可复用的程序化生成器，并输出 10 秒视频。更强的 3D modeling 和 vision，正在把一个 prompt 变成完整世界构建 workflow 的起点。
original: 我最近一直在用 Opus 5.5 玩 Blender。它更好的 3D modeling 和 vision 意味着你可以用一个 prompt 构建整个世界。
具有历史准确性的 1906 年旧金山 Market Street，地震前。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch imagines software becoming durable in a new way: if you loved Google Reader, you could generate and deploy your own version, and keep it forever.
The underlying shift is from consuming a fixed product to owning a generated one. A service can disappear, but the small tool you made for yourself can remain yours.
original: Software will never die again. You liked Google Reader? Cool, you can generate and deploy your own. Yours, forever.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 想象了一种新的软件持久性：如果你喜欢 Google Reader，就自己生成并部署一个版本，而且永久保留。
底层变化是，人们不再只是消费一个固定产品，而是拥有一个为自己生成的产品。服务可以消失，但你做给自己的小工具可以一直在。
original: 软件再也不会消失了。你喜欢 Google Reader？那就生成并部署一个自己的版本。永远属于你。
